chrome-devtools.description: Chrome DevTools Protocol MCP server. Connects to Chromium on port 9222. Start first with: bash scripts/chrome.sh --headless OR --gui. Provides DOM inspection, console logs, network, JS execution, screenshots.

context7.description: Context7 live documentation MCP server for framework, API, and library documentation lookups.

github.description: GitHub MCP server for repository inspection, issues, pull requests, code search, and CI workflow auditing.

playwright.description: Playwright MCP server for headless browser automation, UI inspection, console logs, and E2E verification.

sqlite-safe.description: Safe read-only SQLite MCP server for local database schema inspection and queries.

postgres-safe.description: Safe read-only PostgreSQL MCP server for database schema inspection and analytical queries.

hexana.description: JetBrains Hexana WebAssembly and native binary (ELF/PE/Mach-O) inspection, analysis, and disassembly MCP server.

exa.description: Exa AI neural web search, semantic documentation retrieval, and content extraction MCP server.

figma.description: Figma Developer Context MCP server for extracting layout, Auto Layout, styles, typography, design tokens, and image assets.
